name: @thisisayande/freecode
description: Terminal UI for FreeCode AI coding assistant
//files: npm resolves ignore files from the package directory, and there is no
apps/tui/.gitignore — the repo root one does not apply. Without this
allowlist the tarball picked up everything in the folder, including the
248 MB unpacked), all of src/, and the stray Next.js config files.
The GitHub release already distributes the binaries; npm only needs the
tsc output the `bin` entry points at. LICENSE and README are always
included by npm regardless of this list.
